title: Front-end versus belly dislocation with delayed carry-financing rebalancing

blindness_declaration.law: This document is authored before anyone measures anything for this lane. It declares a mechanism, a rule FAMILY and a representation identity. It contains no outcome numbers, no price/yield signal arithmetic, and no measurement that the D2/I stages will run. The front-end-versus-belly residual named here is a DECLARATION of what D2/I will compute from the committed curve rows; it is not computed in this file, and no descriptive statistic of any curve series appears here. Structural facts cited are read from committed P0/P1/P2 artifacts only.

mechanism.narrative: Condition on the front-end versus belly residual of the official curve (the bill/2-year class against the interpolated belly), with the level coordinate removed. The declared participant is late for an institutional reason: leveraged carry traders financing curve positions in the repo market face financing terms that reset on maintenance and term cadences, so when a front-belly dislocation appears, the carry response cannot act immediately; it is delayed until the next financing reset. Until that reset the dislocation is not fully arbitraged and can extend, which is exactly the interval the proposal conditions on. The economic claim: front-belly dislocation states, once the level factor is removed, carry information that a pure funding or level view does not, because their resolution is timed by an institutional financing calendar, late and mechanical, rather than by continuous arbitrage. Execution is a paired-leg ETP spread (a front-duration bucket against a belly bucket, mapping symbolic until D2/S), deliberately hedging the residual duration so the position is a shape position rather than a nominal-level position. Honest admission: front-end dislocations often coincide with policy-adjacent dates and with shifts in the general yield level; the clock-only shadow kills the policy-clock disguise and the mandatory level-vs-shape decomposition control kills the level disguise, both declared here as executioners.

forced_participant.who: the leveraged carry trader financing front-end versus belly curve positions in the repo market (the LATE participant)
forced_participant.why_late: financing terms reset on maintenance and term cadences, so the position that the dislocation calls for can only be established or unwound at the next financing reset; until then the trader is constrained to hold through the dislocation
forced_participant.forced_counterparty_flow: dealers intermediating repo must absorb the collateral imbalance between resets, transmitting the dislocation into the paired-leg pricing the proposal conditions on
